current_player_sanity_summary.state_anchor_problem: Most headline players still map to elite from Forecast Y1 mean; this suppresses upward probability and mechanically creates excessive modeled decline from the top state.

D2_before_after.conclusion: Probability calibration improved on realized-current-state history but did not transfer to Forecast-Y1 state inference and did not materially improve D2.

recommendation: KEEP A AS TEMPORARY INCUMBENT; FORECAST STATES IMPROVED BUT NOT ENOUGH. Do not promote repaired states + D2 and do not redesign Intrinsic.
major_remaining_defect: Forecast current-state anchoring is not calibrated in the same PIT coordinate used at inference. Historical transitions are learned from realized current production states, while D2 assigns current state from Forecast Y1 mean. On that inference-aligned population, upward movement remains severely underpredicted and downward movement severely overpredicted across QB/RB/WR/TE. The next work should build/validate a PIT Forecast-space or role-evidence current-state anchor, especially for RB/WR/TE, before rerunning frozen D2.

calibration.fundamental_intrinsic_calibration: running at management-artifact write time; prior exact research heads green

next_required_action: Do not create D3 and do not alter D2. Keep A as the temporary Intrinsic primitive. In Forecast, calibrate the current career-state anchor in point-in-time Forecast/role space so inference-state assignment and transition training share the same coordinate; prioritize RB/WR/TE and retain the governed QB meaningful-starter model. Then rerun this exact frozen D2 experiment. TE-premium scoring propagation remains a separate upstream integration repair.
